_meta.description: Cast UI Design Token Reference — quick-navigation map for all 3 token layers
_meta.figmaFormat: DTCG with Figma extensions (aliasData, variableId, scopes)
_meta.colorModeAxis: semantic collection modes: semantic-light / semantic-dark — only COLOR variables change; sizing/typography identical across modes

size.note: Identical scale to space — used for dimensions (width/height)

breakpoint.note: Reference-only foundation scale (Material 3 window size classes). Mobile-first min-width tiers; base is < sm. Not aliased, not on the ThemeProvider theme, not exported by cast-sync. Consumed in code via the useBreakpoint / useResponsiveValue hooks.

intent.description: Semantic color intents for interactive elements

controls.description: Sizing tokens for interactive controls — THESE CHANGE BY THEME

typography.description: Semantic typography scales — constant across themes

modes.semantic-light: default scheme — values listed in this reference

semantic-dark.description: dark scheme — every colour variable re-aliased to existing primitives; runtime values in src/tokens/colors.ts darkColors

mapping.intent/disabled: bg cool-grey/800, fg cool-grey/600, border cool-grey/700
mapping.control/focus-ring-colour: intent/brand/default/active/border (brand-bound; resolves blue/400 dark, blue/500 light, in the default theme)
mapping.intent outlined (default prominence): bg cool-grey/900; fg lifts to palette 400/300/200; border 600/500/400 across default/hover/active
mapping.intent subtle: transparent bg; hover/active bgs use palette 900/800 tints
mapping.intent bold (brand/danger): unchanged from light — white-on-600 stays AA on dark surfaces
mapping.intent bold (neutral): inverted — light fill (cool-grey/200/100/50) with cool-grey/900 fg
mapping.intent/neutral/option: hover cool-grey/700, selected blue/900, selected fg blue/300, selected+hover blue/800
mapping.control/tag: bg cool-grey/700, fg cool-grey/200, remove/hover cool-grey/400

badge.note: All badge spacing is identical across the three densities (verified against component-*.tokens.json); values vary only by the size prop.

colors.solid: intent bold default (bg/border/fg) — fg #FFFFFF; neutral #374151, brand #2563EB, danger #DC2626
colors.subtle: intent subtle default — transparent bg/border; fg neutral #374151, brand #2563EB, danger #DC2626
colors.outline: transparent bg; border intent bold (neutral #374151, brand #2563EB, danger #DC2626); fg intent default (same hues)

progress.note: Track thickness is the one new semantic concept; keyed by the size prop and identical across all three densities (like badge dot-size). The fill binds to intent/{intent}/bold/default/bg; the track background is surface/subtle (non-intent, follows colour mode).

colors.fill: intent bold default bg — neutral #374151, brand #2563EB, danger #DC2626
colors.track: control/progress/track/bg — cool-grey/200 #E5E7EB (light) / cool-grey/700 #374151 (dark), dedicated semantic matching the Toggle off-track

spinner.note: Circular loading indicator. diameter and stroke are both keyed by the size prop and identical across all three densities (like Progress track-height); they alias primitive size/* directly (diameter small/default/large -> size/9,11,12 = 16/24/32; stroke -> size/2,2,3 = 2/2/4). The arc colour binds to intent/{intent}/bold/default/bg (no new var); the track ring is the dedicated control/spinner/track/bg semantic. The ring radius is diameter/2, computed in code. Always indeterminate (animated rotation).

colors.arc: intent bold default bg — neutral #374151, brand #2563EB, danger #DC2626
colors.track: control/spinner/track/bg — cool-grey/200 #E5E7EB (light) / cool-grey/700 #374151 (dark), dedicated semantic matching the Progress track / Toggle off-track

tabs.note: Compound component (Tabs + Tab). gap/paddingX/paddingY/listGap vary by density and alias primitive space/*; indicatorHeight is keyed by the size prop and constant across density (size/2=2 for small/default, size/3=4 for large) like Progress track-height; indicatorRadius is the pill radius/full. Selected indicator + selected label colour bind to intent/{intent}/bold/default/bg; unselected/hover labels use text/description and text/primary; the baseline track is the dedicated control/tabs/track/bg semantic.

colors.indicator: intent bold default bg — neutral #374151, brand #2563EB, danger #DC2626
colors.selectedLabel: same as indicator (intent bold default bg)
colors.track: control/tabs/track/bg — cool-grey/200 #E5E7EB (light) / cool-grey/700 #374151 (dark), dedicated semantic matching the Progress track / Toggle off-track

typography.title: small title/sm (16/24), default title/md (18/24), large title/lg (20/28), medium 500
typography.description: small body/sm (12/18/0.25), default body/md (14/20), large body/lg (16/24), regular 400

toast.note: padding/gap follow the same scale as Alert. Single padding token (uniform), not x/y.

typography.title: small title/sm (16/24), default title/md (18/24), large title/lg (20/28), medium 500
typography.description: small body/sm (12/18/0.25), default body/md (14/20), large body/lg (16/24), regular 400

colors.fg: intent default fg colours the icon/title/description/close (neutral #374151, brand #2563EB, danger #DC2626)

typography.title: small title/sm (16/24), default title/md (18/24), large title/lg (20/28), medium 500
typography.subtitle+body: small body/sm (12/18/0.25), default body/md (14/20), large body/lg (16/24), regular 400

avatar.note: Avatar diameter varies by size AND density (verified against component-*.tokens.json). icon-size and the initials typography scale are constant across density (keyed by the size prop).

colors.bg: colours/cool-grey/100 (#F3F4F6) for initials/icon types; image fills the frame (no bg)
colors.fg: intent/neutral/default/default/fg (#374151) for initials text and icon glyph

divider.note: No density-varying tokens. Horizontal stretches to container width; vertical to container height.

tooltip.note: Only two sizes (no large). Padding varies by size AND density. Surface is the neutral/bold (dark) intent.

popover.note: Content padding varies by size AND density (verified against component-*.tokens.json). Radius and arrow size are constant. direction = the edge the arrow sits on.

skeleton.note: No density-varying tokens — skeletons mirror the layout of the real content. width/height/radius are overridable props; an opacity pulse runs by default.

bottomSheet.note: Bottom-anchored modal sheet. Hugs content up to ~90% screen height then scrolls, so there are no size variants. padding/gap vary by density and alias primitive space/*; border-radius (top corners) aliases radius/4, handle-width aliases size/13, handle-height aliases size/3, handle-gap aliases space/5, all constant across density. The card surface reuses surface.overlay (bg/border); the scrim reuses overlay.scrimOpacity; the drag handle is the one new colour control/bottom-sheet/handle/bg (cool-grey/300 light, cool-grey/600 dark), mirrored as scheme.bottomSheet.handle.

link.note: Inline/standalone text link. Colour comes from the intent subtle fg (brand default), text/primary on hover, shared disabled fg. The one spacing token is link/{size}/gap (icon to label), density-varying. Typography uses the label scale; icon size follows the named Icon scale (small->16, default->20, large->24).

breadcrumbs.note: Compound (Breadcrumbs + Breadcrumb). Links use the brand subtle fg, current item uses text/primary, separators use text/description. The one spacing token is breadcrumbs/{size}/gap (row gap between items and separators, and the leading-icon to label gap), density-varying. Default separator is the chevron_right icon; a non-symbol string renders as text.

codeBlock.note: Monospaced code on surface/subtle with the overlay border. Code text is text/primary; gutter/title/language/copy icon use text/description. padding+gap vary by size and density; border-radius is constant (radius/3). Typography uses the body scale in the mono family. Copy uses the web Clipboard API plus an onCopy callback (zero-dependency).

constant: default width 320 (code constant, not a token)
drawer.note: Edge-anchored modal panel (left/right/top/bottom). Hugs an edge with no size variants, like BottomSheet. Surface reuses overlay tokens; scrim reuses overlay.scrimOpacity. The panel is square (no radius). padding+gap vary by density.

backdrop.note: Full-screen scrim. No new tokens: reuses scheme.overlay.scrimOpacity (a black scrim) and fades with open. invisible makes it transparent but still press-catching.

menu.note: Transient action overlay. Dedicated menu/* tokens + scheme.menu.item colour slice (mirrors select shape, namespaced to menu, reuses the same semantic colour values, no new semantic vars). Item spacing varies by density; size prop drives typography. Surface reuses overlay tokens. Danger items use intent/danger/subtle.

toggleButtonGroup.note: Segmented row. Dedicated toggle-button-group/* tokens (mirror button paddings, namespaced). Selected fills with intent/{intent}/bold; unselected is transparent with neutral text + neutral hover; group draws one neutral border with dividers. exclusive => single-select (string|null), else multi (string[]).

constant: height derived from padding (no height token)
appBar.note: Top bar. Dedicated app-bar/* tokens. Colour from the intent system: bold=filled, default=plain bar with bottom divider, subtle=transparent. Title + leadingIcon inherit the bar fg; trailing is a free slot. Title scale by size; spacing by density.

slider.note: Draggable track+fill+thumb (PanResponder, zero-dep). track-height + thumb-size keyed by size, constant across density (like Progress). Fill reuses intent/{intent}/bold/default/bg; track is the dedicated control/slider/track/bg semantic (scheme.slider.track, cool-grey/200 light, cool-grey/700 dark); thumb is a white circle with an intent ring.

speedDial.note: FAB + expanding actions. fab-size/action-size keyed by size, constant across density; gap density-varying. FAB fills intent/{intent}/bold; actions are neutral surface buttons with tag-styled labels (scheme.tag). Optional scrim reuses overlay.scrimOpacity.

table.note: Built from Views (no RN table). Dedicated table/* cell padding (density-varying). Colours from the dedicated scheme.table slice (header, border, rowHover, stripe, selected) reusing surface/neutral/brand-subtle values, no new semantic vars. striped shades alternate body rows; hoverable highlights on hover; onPress rows are pressable + selectable.

autocomplete.note: The Select combobox specialised for client-side filtering. Reuses input tokens for the field (is-a Input) and select tokens + scheme.select.option colours for the dropdown (is-a value-option). No new tokens. Type to filter by label; clearable; noOptionsText when nothing matches.

themePattern.description: ~75% of tokens are constant across themes. Only padding, gap, and spacing tokens vary.
themePattern.note: Avatar diameter and Popover padding DO vary by density — see their entries.

constant: none — flush style has no radius; chevron/icon use the named Icon scale keyed by size
accordion.note: Compound component (Accordion + AccordionItem). type single|multiple. Flush/divided style, neutral only. gap/paddingX/paddingY vary by density and alias primitive space/*. The header label uses text/primary (disabled -> disabled fg); the chevron (chevron_right, rotates 90deg when open) and optional leadingIcon use the named Icon scale keyed by the size prop and bind the same fg as the label. Header hover/press background reuse the neutral subtle intent (neutral/subtle/hover|active/bg). The divider between items is surface/overlay/border at control border width (like Divider). No new colour tokens.

motion.collection: motion (single mode — constant across density and colour mode)
motion.figmaSpecPage: Motion page in cast-ui-kit (animated cards keyframed with the exact beziers)
motion.castSync: cast-sync v4 exports this collection as the cast-theme.json motion block
